notes: New horror mod: Server-Side Horror (Mods > Converted - off until you turn it on). Quiet, slow and rare: someone stands far off and stares, and is gone when you look. Players join the game who aren't there. Mining behind the walls, footsteps where no one walks, a face right before your eyes when you stand still. Torches go out, signs and heads turn up near you.
It starts after the world's third day and stays rare on purpose. Works in singleplayer and on servers with the HybridHorrorKit plugin; only players who turn it on are haunted.
